topic: Claiming remedial massage on the spot with HICAPS

slides.headline: Claim your massage before you leave
slides.sub: How HICAPS on-the-spot claiming works for remedial massage.

slides.title: What HICAPS actually is
slides.body: HICAPS is the terminal at our front desk that sends your claim to your health fund straight away. If your extras cover includes remedial massage, the benefit comes off on the spot.

slides.title: What to bring
slides.body: Bring your health fund card to your appointment. Some funds also accept digital cards through their app, so it's worth checking with yours beforehand if you often leave your wallet at home.

slides.title: You pay the gap
slides.body: Your fund pays its benefit and you pay the difference, known as the gap, on the day. The gap depends on your fund, your level of cover and how much of your annual limit is left.

slides.title: Check your cover first
slides.body: Ask your fund: is remedial massage included on my extras? What's my annual limit? Is there a waiting period? Knowing this upfront avoids surprises at the desk.

slides.title: Plan around your annual limit
slides.body: Extras limits usually reset once a year, depending on your fund. If you book massage regularly, spacing sessions across the year helps your limit go further. Your fund can tell you when yours resets.

slides.headline: Bring your card, claim on the day
slides.body: Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physiotherapy tailor each session to your goals, and our front desk processes HICAPS claims on the spot.

caption:
No paperwork, no waiting for a refund. Here's how HICAPS works for massage.

HICAPS is the terminal at our front desk that sends your claim straight to your health fund. If your extras cover includes remedial massage, the benefit comes off on the spot and you pay the gap on the day. Bring your health fund card, and check with your fund whether it accepts a digital card.

Before your first visit, ask your fund three things: is remedial massage included on my extras, what's my annual limit, and is there a waiting period? Limits usually reset once a year, so spacing sessions out can help yours go further.

Our remedial massage therapists tailor each session to your goals. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
